reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled input (param). Data flows from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest01267') (line 43) to map53210.put('keyB-53210', param) (line 60), then retrieved via map53210.get('keyB-53210') (line 62) into variable bar. Variable bar is written directly to the HTTP response body via response.getWriter().write(bar) (line 49) without any HTML encoding or sanitization. The X-XSS-Protection header is disabled ('0'), exacerbating the risk. This constitutes a reflected XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: Input stored in map and retrieved back into bar without modification
